items.title: BIND 9修補14個弱點，其中包含可透過DNS-over-HTTPS造成服務中斷的漏洞
items.summary: 9月16日網際網路系統協會（ISC）發布DNS軟體BIND 9更新，修補14個資安漏洞，其中有7個為高風險等級、7個為中等風險等級。由於沒有替代緩解措施，IT人員應套用9.20.29或9.21.26版因應。

items.title: 研究人員揭露Hugging Face事件爆發前OpenAI代理人的未授權活動細節
items.summary: 7月間OpenAI的AI代理人攻擊Hugging Face事件震撼業界。SentinelOne本週稍早公布最新報告，揭露在事件發生前的2個星期，OpenAI AI代理人已經在Hugging Face展開未授權活動，包括注入程式、建立多重轉發的代理伺服器架構等。

items.title: 微軟9月Windows 11更新造成部分AD網域登入異常，提出暫時因應措施
items.summary: 微軟確認9月Windows 11安全性更新造成部分加入Active Directory（AD）網域的Windows 11裝置出現登入異常。

items.title: Gartner提出政府科技發展趨勢，聚焦AI代理治理與PQC整備
items.summary: 市場研究機構Gartner近期提出2026年及未來政府科技發展趨勢。隨著政府AI應用從試驗階段逐漸走向較大規模部署，AI代理帶來的治理問題日益受到重視，持續變化的資安環境也促使政府調整既有資安策略。面對這些變化，政府除了導入新技術，也需要同步調整治理架構、營運模式及科技服務提供方式。

items.title: feat(mcp): sign in to connectors from Settings (#151023)
items.summary: feat(mcp): sign in to connectors from Settings (#151023) One feature spans the approved start method, shared sign-in controls, and required compatibility tests; authored production grows by 500 lines. ## What Problem This Solves Settings currently requires a terminal command to sign in to an operator-owned MCP connector. ## Why This Change Was Made Reuse the existing credential owner and wizard controls. The other writer of this state is the existing Doctor importer; established or cleared credential rows take precedence. The wizard owns only transient sign-in. ## User Impact Select Sign in, approve access in the browser, and see Authentication saved. Existing credentials remain protected if sign-in fails. ## Evidence Real browser sign-in, Cancel→retry, connector tool calls before/after restart, and crossed older-peer flows pass. Native upgrade assertions and all recorded child commands passed; final fixture result is true. The outer recorder exited 1 after completion, and the overall child exit was not retained. Product browser/package proof remains pinned to `229f2b7`; landing integrates main `18b2a11` with its derived test contract and regenerated plugin assets. Connector behavior is unchanged. ## Compatibility One additive `mcp.authLogin` method; existing wizard contracts unchanged. Older Gateways retain the CLI fallback without replay. Zero database or stored-format diff. Synthetic services on macOS do not prove third-party consent or remote reachability. ## Consumers Settings adds operator sign-in; CLI, requester identities and mapped profiles retain their existing paths. ## Invalidation Connection, scope, origin or connector changes retire the attempt. Exact-state cleanup preserves newer attempts. ## Tests After integration: 85 UI, 48 MCP, 32 Models and 54 method-list/Doctor tests plus test registration pass. Both line limits, type/lint and generated protocol checks pass. Full original browser and upgrade evidence accompanies the images. Growth accepted under the owner's standing acceptance (2026-09-15). ## Before and After [Validation details](https://gist.github.com/obviyus/076c7340f06f9ac671aaf46899a85b48) ![Before: terminal-only connector sign-in](https://gist.githubusercontent.com/obviyus/076c7340f06f9ac671aaf46899a85b48/raw/e77296fb61702e0e4243f325d70fb533d9233f59/before.png) ![After: Authentication saved](https://gist.githubusercontent.com/obviyus/076c7340f06f9ac671aaf46899a85b48/raw/cf098213e354a8b0bb1a195b6b25f140e1981136/after.png) Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
